narr: A pre-frontal trough brought thunderstorms into the area during the evening of May 11. Isolated severe thunderstorms brought hail up to 1.5 inches and wind gusts of 58 mph, along with localized street flooding.
ev: Heavy rain causing flooding of residential streets and yards.
Residential street and yard flooding reported along Wolverton Creek.
lsr: HEAVY RAIN CAUSING FLOODING OF YARDS IN RESIDENTIAL AREA.
REDIDENTIAL STREET AND YARD FLOODING ALONG WOLVERTON CREEK.
